answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a grove header. Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a knoll spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 66 answers an epoch thus costs 60 real forward passes, and the zenith record lets any auditor recompute the check. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
